name: openshelf
description: Local-first DuckDB knowledge-base retrieval tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Local DuckDB knowledge-base retrieval for Codex
interface.longDescription: OpenShelf lets Codex build and query local PDF knowledge bases with DuckDB-backed BM25 retrieval, evidence labels, page inspection, optional technical-result indexing, and closed/open corpus reasoning boundaries.
